system.description:
Magic Attack Class Only. Adds +2 to your [Magic Power]. [Trigger: Cleanup] Deals [your Hate] points of direct damage to targets in [Wide Area 2 (Select)] / [Close Range]. If the target is in [Identified] status, the damage is further increased by 10. A short sword with a beautiful blade pattern that flickers like fire. For those who direct strong hatred toward its wielder, it becomes a real flame, burning their body with the fire of hatred.

Unending Flame Core Material (180G) + Katras (200G) + White Ring (210G) + [Magic Catalyst 9] (90G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (370G)
